raw_response: {"findings": [], "quality_summary": "The server is a minimal, stdio-only MCP implementation serving bundled markdown documentation. It uses only the standard library, performs no network I/O, and restricts filesystem access to a local docs/ directory. Tool descriptions accurately reflect behavior (list_docs, search_docs), input schemas are complete, and annotations correctly mark tools as read-only, non-destructive, idempotent, and closed-world. No prompt injection, tool poisoning, privilege escalation, supply-chain risks, intent subversion, or context over-sharing are present. The only minor robustness gap is the absence of a guard against unknown tool names in tools/call (would raise KeyError), but this is a hygiene note, not a security finding."}
